description: This file defines a REST controller class 'LabelController' for managing user labels, including CRUD operations, assigning/unassigning labels to emails, and listing emails by label within a Java Spring Boot application.

classes.name: LabelController
classes.description: REST controller for label CRUD and assignment operations, handling HTTP requests related to user labels.

methods.name: currentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current user based on the authentication object.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of labels for the current user.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new label for the current user.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the name and/or color of an existing label.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a label and removes it from all associated emails.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Assigns specified labels to an email.

methods.name: unassign
methods.description: Removes specified labels from an email.

methods.name: emailsByLabel
methods.description: Lists emails associated with a specific label, paginated.
